body: You escorted a caravan south from Aeloria. On the road, a young black dragon named Vrass took your contract wagon — and took Torren's lifetime service in exchange for your lives. Sylas quietly moved the sealed Coin Cipher chest into his Bag of Holding before Vrass could see it. Sera Vey rides hidden in your wagon, seeking her sister Mira, held in Ironhold by a merchant named Halvor. You reached Ironhold's northern gate at last light and camped. Dawn brings the gate.
